scope: Analyse quantitative descriptive et de robustesse sur mesures empiriques versionnées uniquement.

tests.name: replication_presolar_returned_samples
tests.criterion: standardized descriptive difference < 2 for comparable SiC and O-rich abundances in Bennu versus Ryugu
tests.interpretation_limit: Descriptive cross-mission consistency, not a population meta-analysis.

tests.name: water_isotopologue_cross_system_consistency
tests.criterion: V883 Ori versus 67P derived D2O/H2O standardized difference < 2
tests.interpretation_limit: Cross-system compatibility does not prove direct lineage.

tests.name: early_solar_chronological_order
tests.criterion: Four selected age gaps preserve the stated ordering at > 5 conservative combined sigma
tests.interpretation_limit: Chronological ordering does not by itself identify the heating mechanism.

tests.name: same_object_event_linked_state_change
tests.criterion: EC 53 crystalline forsterite and enstatite features absent in quiescence and detected during burst
tests.interpretation_limit: Direct temporal association; outward transport remains unobserved.

tests.name: streamer_observation_replication
tests.criterion: At least two independent observed protostellar systems with streamers >= 1000 au
tests.interpretation_limit: Replicates the physical channel class, not the protosolar history.

tests.name: long_term_parent_body_reactivation
tests.criterion: Returned Ryugu samples retain a measured late fluid-flow archive > 1000 Myr after formation
tests.interpretation_limit: Cause of the late event is not used as evidence.

tests.name: empirical_graph_robustness
tests.criterion: Report strict archive-sequence reachability and all analogue/non-unique bottlenecks without forcing closure
tests.interpretation_limit: Graph reachability is an evidence audit, not a physical simulation.

tests.name: evidence_family_ablation
tests.criterion: Remove each evidence mode in turn and report lost stage coverage and strict-path loss
tests.interpretation_limit: Sensitivity analysis of the evidence base only.
